dialogue.qiusmob.consciousness.first_dea: §4§l§n§oYou killed me. Now... I will follow you forever.
dialogue.qiusmob.consciousness.touch: §4§l§n§oDon't move. Let me look at you.
dialogue.qiusmob.consciousness.hit_by_ta: §4§l§n§oYou finally touched me... a little more, please?
dialogue.qiusmob.consciousness.angry_oth: §4§l§n§oWho allowed you to touch me? Every inch of me belongs to him.
dialogue.qiusmob.consciousness.protect_t: §4§l§n§oHow dare you touch him? You'll regret it.
§4§l§n§oHe is mine. Even one more glance is a sin.
dialogue.qiusmob.consciousness.idle_watc: §4§l§n§oYour smile today was beautiful—but only for others. I don't like that.
§4§l§n§oYou seem to be thinking of someone else. It's fine. In the end, you can only think of me.

message.qiusmob.consciousness.spawned: §4You killed me. Now, I follow you.
